target_customer: Pakistani retail investors and employees saving for retirement, plus qualified clients for advisory
problem: Retirement savings products in Pakistan are expensive and hard to access; the company frames the gap as the fee difference between 401k plans and brokerage accounts.
business_model: Investment advisory fee (1% annual advisory fee with a fee-at-risk arrangement for qualified clients), custody at Interactive Brokers
product_category: Fintech, digital investment advisory and retirement savings

founders.name: Farooq Tirmizi
founders.background_notes: YC page says first-time founder with 12 years in financial services and financial journalism in Pakistan and the US; employers and education not listed.

founders.name: Uzair Mahmud
founders.background_notes: YC profile lists only 'Tinkerer'. CTO title from company site; technical flag inferred from the title.

competitors.name: Mahaana Wealth
competitors.what: Digital wealth management and retirement investing platform in Pakistan, same YC W22 batch

technical_complexity.rationale: Advisory platform with custody integration and securities licensing, mostly standard engineering plus regulatory work.

defensibility.rationale: Holds an SECP advisor license and later acquired Trikl for its approved digital asset management status; licensing slows entrants.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established; Mahaana, a same-batch rival, launched a digital retirement product with IGI Life in 2025.

market_need_then: Pakistan had no 401k equivalent beyond the voluntary pension system and low retail investing penetration; the company cites the fee gap between 401k plans and brokerage accounts.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community material about the brand itself found; the name resembles the historic Elphinstone Street in Karachi but no source links them.

outcome_analysis: Elphinstone is a Pakistan based YC W22 advisory and retirement platform that had launched its app by January 2022 and grew through a licensed advisory model. It acquired Trikl in October 2024 to gain a digital asset management license and add provident fund style products. It remains active; total funding is reported inconsistently and no priced institutional round was found.
notes: Unverified funding: MENAbytes says $1.5M raised to date from Soma Capital, Hi2 Global and angels (article date not captured); CB Insights lists a $0.5M convertible note 2022-03-29 and $800K total; another profile says $1.55M including Flybridge and Rally Cap; a search snippet says about $300K pre-seed from friends and family before YC. Sources conflict and no round has a dated primary source, so no rounds are recorded. Acquired Trikl, announced 2024-10-29, undisclosed seven-digit value (MENAbytes). Pakistan Today article fetch returned 403. Competitor Mahaana's source is dated about seven months after the batch start; no pre-batch competitor source found. Completeness pass: a 500K convertible note dated 2022-03-29 rests on a single database (CB Insights); Seedtable lists a 2022-03 seed with Soma Capital, Y Combinator and The Community Fund and no amount, probably the same round. Press (MENAbytes, 2024-10-29) says 1.5M raised to date, more than the recorded rounds, so the gap is unrecorded; Dawn via Seedtable gave 1.2M by 2022-10 and Profit (Pakistan Today) 1.1M.
